findings.statement: Convergence rank 1 (score 4.5197). Tumour-up: TCGA log2FC 9.712, protein log2FC 2.269. Tractable modalities AB, PR, SM (AB: Advanced Clinical). Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_3), IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_2), SULTHIAME (PHASE_4), ETHOXZOLAMIDE (WITHDRAWAL). UniProt: cell membrane / microvillus membrane, so it suits antibody and imaging use and is a strong tissue biomarker. DepMap: ccRCC mean effect 0.051 and no dependent lines, so the case rests on being a surface antigen, not on dependency.

Convergence rank 3 (score 4.2143). Tumour-up: TCGA log2FC 7.09 (purity-robust). Tractable modalities AB, OC, PR (AB and OC: Advanced Clinical). Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB (PHASE_2), VORSETUZUMAB (PHASE_1), VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN (PHASE_1), MDX-1411 (PHASE_1). UniProt: plasma membrane ligand of CD27, so it is an antibody/ADC/CAR-T surface target. DepMap mean effect in ccRCC lines is 0.251 (no dependency), so the rationale is antigen targeting, not essentiality. No mutation data.

Established ccRCC target (HIF-2 alpha). Open Targets association score 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN (APPROVAL). DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -0.143 vs 0.157 in other lines, selectivity 0.3, fraction of ccRCC lines dependent 0.208, padj 0.061, not common essential. This is a modest, partly selective dependency that is consistent with VHL-loss biology.

Established ccRCC target (VEGFR2). Open Targets association score 0.4566. Tractable as antibody and small molecule. Approved drugs listed include PAZOPANIB HYDROCHLORIDE, AXITINIB, TIVOZANIB HYDROCHLORIDE and CABOZANTINIB S-MALATE (all APPROVAL). DepMap was not queried for KDR here, because it acts on the vasculature, not on the tumour cell.

Established ccRCC target. Open Targets association score 0.525. Drugs include RIDAFOROLIMUS (APPROVAL). DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -1.52, all ccRCC lines dependent (fraction 1.0), selectivity 0.354, padj 0.011, but flagged common essential, so there is a toxicity/therapeutic-window risk. The dependency is strong but not tumour-specific.

Top Open Targets association with ccRCC (score 0.6466). Somatic driver: 247 of 511 tumours mutated (frequency 0.483), recurrent, padj 0.0. It is the upstream cause of HIF-2 alpha stabilisation, which justifies the EPAS1/belzutifan axis. The gene is lost, so it is not directly druggable.

Open Targets association score 0.6348. Recurrent driver: 185 of 511 tumours (frequency 0.362), obs/exp 43.498, padj 4.59e-239. Loss-of-function chromatin remodeller with no direct drug; it is useful for stratification, not as a direct target.

Open Targets association score 0.6079. Recurrent driver: 53 of 511 tumours (frequency 0.104), padj 7.81e-50. Loss-of-function tumour suppressor; association and genetics only, with no direct drug evidence retrieved.

Convergence rank 7 (score 3.9643). Tumour-up: TCGA log2FC 4.685, protein log2FC 2.709. TCGA Cox log HR 0.301 (padj 0.00479), so high expression is associated with worse survival. Tractable (predicted) but no drugs listed. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.316, so no dependency; it is a prognostic or metabolic biomarker, not a validated target.

Convergence rank 2 (score 4.2206). Tumour-down: TCGA log2FC -4.741, protein log2FC -2.273. Higher expression is associated with better survival (Cox log HR -0.358, padj 0.000023). Open Targets score 0.0701, no drugs. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.156, so no dependency. It is a loss-type diagnostic and prognostic biomarker.

Convergence rank 4 (score 4.1667). Tumour-down: TCGA log2FC -6.154, protein log2FC -2.264. Higher expression is associated with better survival (Cox log HR -0.402). Drugs listed: PROBENECID (PHASE_4) and PRATOSARTAN (PHASE_3), but these are transporter substrates/inhibitors not tied to ccRCC. A loss biomarker, not a plausible ccRCC target.

Convergence rank 5 (score 4.1052). Open Targets association score 0.4049 (genetic association 0.519). Tumour-up: TCGA log2FC 3.989, protein log2FC 1.837, purity-robust. Target profile score 4.1314. Tractability labelled predicted and no drugs listed. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.002, so no dependency. This is an untested tractable candidate.

Convergence rank 6 (score 4.0695). Open Targets association score 0.4532 (genetic association 0.7338). Tumour-down: TCGA log2FC -3.721, protein log2FC -1.235. No drugs. DepMap ccRCC mean effect 0.143, so no dependency. An association-driven loss biomarker.

caveats: The convergence ranking was only read for the top 12 rows; the 40-row output was too large to open, so genes ranked 13 to 40 were not assessed.

DepMap evidence is only a null/weak signal for CA9, CD70, NNMT, ALDOB, SLC22A8, SCARB1 and PIGR; those numbers come from the convergence_ranking rows. DepMap was not queried for KDR, VHL, PBRM1 or BAP1.
STRING interactions and KDM5C, SETD2, AKT1 and other top Open Targets genes were not examined, to stay within the call budget.
Open Targets drug stages are as returned and do not imply ccRCC-specific approval. Examples are ETHOXZOLAMIDE (WITHDRAWAL), PROBENECID, and the MTOR-listed PERHEXILINE.

Several top-ranked biomarkers (ALDOB, SLC22A8, UMOD, FABP1, NPHS2, MT1G) are down-regulated kidney-tubule genes. Some of this loss may reflect loss of normal tissue, although purity analysis was included in the ranking.
